description:
Dive into the dystopian chaos of Anime Girls - Wasteland Shootout, a riveting top-down shooter where you command the Wasteland Vixens, a squad of fearless anime heroines battling marauders in a devastated world. Equip futuristic weapons, navigate treacherous post-apocalyptic landscapes, and customize each character with unique abilities to survive explosive, action-packed encounters.

Features:
- Intense Combat: Experience fast-paced shootouts and powerful abilities.
- Dynamic Environments: Fight through scorched deserts, abandoned cities, and mutant-infested forests.
- Character Customization: Upgrade and personalize your heroines with new skills, weapons, and gear.
- Compelling Narrative: Unravel the story behind the cataclysm that turned the earth into a wasteland and fight to secure a better future for your team.

Uncover mysteries, gather loot, and build your base—all while unleashing adrenaline-pumping action and strategy in a world where survival is just the beginning. Rally your team, aim true, and reclaim the wasteland!
name: Anime Girls Wasteland Shootout
intro: Lead fearless heroines through explosive, post-apocalyptic battles.
